Many people did not know, and some of them had not even been sent an e-mail. There was a cocky staff at the counter, we didn't care. hotel transfer everything was arranged but thanks to viva aerobus all was cancelled. We had to call the hotel at night. Fortunately, they took us on the plane the next day, but the seats we paid for are always different. We also had a weight problem. I can't explain how bad the flight was anyway.

Waited in line for an hour and 30min for them to Let know that they have a new policy that requires that I need a notarized letter from my spouse they couldn’t wait 30 min for my husband to come back to have the on call notary get the letter signed. I called the customer service line to let them know my issue and I asked if I can cancel or reschedule the flight they said unfortunately I would need to open a case and they would need to review. There is nothing to review! I am so disappointed. I am disputing with my credit card company as services not rendered. I did have a letter written from my son at the time of travel based on what the US gov website and they didn’t accept this. I even had my husband take a picture with my son with it.

Scam#1 There is a lot of flight attendant in the cabin 😳 but they Don t do any king of service during a 2.5 hours flight ..they past so fast with the galley that is amazing ... No in-flight service Scam#2 On my way back the morning after show up to the desk to pick up my boarding so call vip ticket ..surprise they give my seat away just like that no answer provide ..told me to go in a corner and wait Tha someone call me ....1 hour later in a none air conditioning Airport I start to wonder if I will miss my flight ...try to talk to the incharge (real joke unprofessional no communication ) finally I bought chocolate peanut and give to one of front desk agent and I was back in the game...can you belive that ...peanut are always good for 🐒. So here is my story I will never fly with this company again Big no no

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER!
reviews.text: We booked our flight in advance and when I tried to check in to see my seats it said there were not seats. They oversold/overbooked my flight and I had to call the airline so they could move my flight earlier. When I passed security I checked my boarding pass on my phone and it said an exact gate and I when I arrived it said Cancun which was where I wanted to go but when I asked someone they said that it wasn’t there so I had to go look for another gate, since I arrived to the airport with anticipation I had a lot of time but when they started calling people by their “zones” they didn’t even call then in order and they were moving people out of the way because they didn’t have a seat in the airplane, when the person starting calling out the zones (which were 8) she went in order from 1-6 but then she did 8-7? Which was ridiculous in my head because seven goes before 8. When I started heading to baggage claim a very kind woman told me I had forgotten my hat on the plane so I thanked her and went back, when I got back to the plane where there’s the door I saw another guy there and he was waiting there because his girlfriend had forgotten her purse in the plane but the security woman said they don’t return anything, she told me that I had to go to a special kiosk and figure it out there but some of my friends that I know that had flown through Viva Aerobús said that if you forget something they never give it back to you. One of my friends forgot her cellphone in the plane and they told her to go to the kiosk and they never gave it back to her so I wasn’t going to risk my chances. When the security woman finally came out with the woman’s bag the guy just left and so when I told her I left smut hat on my seat she said that they had it and that I should go to the kiosk, she said that three times but I wasn’t really going to take my handed so I just stood there waiting for my hat and until she finally gave it to me I left. Summary: They overbook flights, misguide you and they don’t have any organization. They also never return your stuff if you lose it or forget it in the plane, so I would never recommend this airline If I had to say one positive thing it would be that the AC was nice.
reviews.author: Regina Cuellar

reviews.title: Very bad service. They scam you.
reviews.text: Grade far below 0 I was on time at the gate. Then the personnel sent me away to immigration with not clear reasons, where they said everything was fine. When I came back, they just closed the gate. And then they said I was too late but the flight was overbooked anyway so I couldnt go anyway. So they tricked me to leave the gate and then put the blame on you in being late at the gate so they could solve their overbooked flight over the passengers back. Didnt get a refund because they said I was late. I would avoid this company at any cost.

Are you serious how do you expect an elderly person to stay in and airport for 10 hrs. They could not even ask other passengers to give up there seat. Wow sorry there is nothing we can do? Really again very disappointed and will never recommend this airline and will never fly it again.

reviews.text: Avoid this Airline, My kids traveled with a friend, they arrived 3 hours in advance to check in, complete their long and bad process, waited long time to get on board, my son needed to use the restroom, he went running while my friend and daughter still waiting, the girl at the gate open it and call to get on board, saw them there, they let her know that he was coming and she closed the gate leaving them stranded at the airport. It was a mater of seconds and she didnt care, told them to go and book a new flight, we tried and were told that we need to pay again. reviews.author: Dalia E L

reviews.title: USD 778.50 to correct date of birth mistake on reservation that was not my fault
reviews.text: I recently booked Mexico City->Madrid->Mexico City->Tuxtla Gutierrez with the first two legs on Iberia and the final leg on Viva Aerobus. I did this all on Iberia's website as they have some sort of partnership with Viva Aerobus. Iberia's website has a problem where you can't select anything except for "1" for the passenger's day of birth. I saw that other people have had this problem and they called Iberia to get it corrected. However, in my case after I entered the passengers' passport information, I called Iberia and the agent told me that the birth dates were now correct. But they did not update on the Viva Aerobus leg according to their web site. I called Viva Aerobus and they told me that to change this mistake they would have to re-issue the tickets and I would have to pay a change fee of USD 370 plus tax for each ticket. How outrageous is this??? The change fee was greater than the cost of the domestic flight in Mexico but they calculated it based on the fact it was part of an expensive international booking. Why could Iberia update it easily at no cost but not Viva Aerobus? Both are "international" flights. Why do I feel like a robbery victim?
reviews.author: Mark In EC

reviews.title: Do not book!
reviews.text: Avoid this booking with this company! Horrible experience our flight was delayed by 4+ hours. We are currently still sitting in the plane and they keep giving bs excuses! Pay the extra money to fly with a well reviewed airline company trust me it will save you aggravations and stress!!!!
reviews.author: Sonia R

reviews.title: Trash company, lost my bag and illegally refused compensation
reviews.text: Avoid this airline at all costs! They lost my luggage, found it a day later and then made it very very hard to get the bag back. I was told that I was entitled to compensation for the purchases I made to replace essential items in the interim (since I received my bag almost a month later). This compensation is, in fact, required by US law. I bought minimal items to cover myself in the month, and then submitted a compensation claim with all receipts and information. They then REFUSED to compensate me, instead offering me travel credit amounting to significantly less than I had claimed! Imagine, travel credit with the airline that lost your baggage - an airline that only has flights on the other side of the world to where I live. It is just plain illegal to operate within the United States and not adhere to their laws. They really are just waiting to screw over the wrong person who actually decides to sue them. Let's hope that day comes soon.

When we asked why they said they didnt know why. We called costumer service and they gave us the runaround they even got bothered and hung up twice. All we were asking was for was the price difference supervisor pretty much called my wife a liar because their staff didn’t change it in the system. They ended up telling my wife to email a complaint and hung up. DON’T FLY WITH THEM UNLESS WANT TO ROBBED!!! Viva aerobus stole our money!!!

Call the airline and was told that I needed a doctors note. Wanted to see a doctor got a note and sent it to the airline as directed. Call back to see if my flight had been able to be changed only to be told that I don’t I provide it was not sufficient enough, but I needed a different type of document one but the person on the phone never informed me I need it when asked if I purchased a new ticket with my luggage, at least be covered as I had already paid for it on my flight, they said no. We've made over 40 phone calls to the luggage department and sent many emails including all documentation required for compensation. We talked with so many different representatives and all are incompetent, responsive, and inconsistent in their responses. Three months ago, they indicated that our luggage was found but needed an email to release from Customs, they even described the luggage. Then it was "lost" again. I don't trust this airline. It should not be operating. I am Mexican and do not support this Mexican airline. I am submitting a formal complaint to the US Department of Transportation otherwise, their scam will never stop.

The planes are also clearly not cleaned between flights as you will find trash and dirty seats. In general they are absolutely terrible and worth paying more for a better airline than all the trouble they make you go through. Customer service is not helpful, don’t help you when you miss connections, nor refund money even when you by the flexible option. Probably the worst airline I have ever flown and I have been to over 30 countries.

reviews.title: Horrible Airline

They put us in another flight in random seats apart from each other and made it to Cancun sometime around 1 am. Over 12 hours trying to get to our destination and I have to add… all of this WHILE HAVING MY 6 MONTH OLD BABY WITH ME. All the stress and pain we went through and then not getting anything back in exchange (not even the money back from our VIP seats that we paid extra for and that we never got to use). Desk ladies were not helpful and mean. The planes have very tight seats (98 lb lady here) I am skinny and thought the seats were small. They also delivered out luggage late. I also recently tried to give this airline a second chance and guess what. I booked a flight with months of anticipation for this year and they sent me an email that my already confirmed flight changed the departure time 4 hours later. COME ON!!! I want my money back. I just was in the phone trying to get my money back and after 1 hr waiting on the phone (they even tell you what number you are and how long it will take) they said: “ You are now number 1, someone will be with you in 15 seconds” ha, and guess what? They cut the damn call. This airline is horrible. Definitely not booking again with you.

They refused any reimbursement for the hotel that was paid for at the destination, no accommodation for the night, no food, not even WATER on plane!!! How sick is that! reviews.title: Bunch of Scammers
reviews.text: I check in my bags online 72 hours prior to my flight because I found out the hard was that Mexican airlines can charge you up to 3x's for not checking in your bags early. I went to Viva Aerobus website and check in 3 bags (15kg each). The day of my flight, we went to check-in our bags thinking everything was paid for and was told by the check-in clerk that I made a mistake and checked in the wrong type of luggage. So I had to pay TWICE to check-in my luggage. He said he could not give me a refund there, but I could call customer service at Viva Aerobus and they would provide a refund. I called today and they REFUSE to give me a refund because it was MY fault for choosing the wrong type of luggage and I only had 24 hours to call to correct MY mistake (check-in clerk failed to mention this to me....). HORRIBLY customer service, bunch of scammers!
reviews.author: Martha M

reviews.title: Criminal Airline! Broke into my suitcase and stole my wallet!
reviews.text: I landed just a couple of hours ago with this airkine flying from Cancun to Mexico City. At first I found the service ok, the staff on the airline seemed polite enough and spoke a little bit if English. However everything turned to disaster when I landed. My suitcase lock had been deliberately broken or cut and the suitcase button was also damaged so that the wheel was buckled and could not be pushed normally. Nothing was actually taken as there was nothing particularly valuable inside the section the managed to open. I did report it to their desk inside the area where you collect your luggage and they were helpful enough to give me a report for my insurance company but said they don't pay compensation. Minutes later I realised my wallet which I had got out to use a card to pay for some drinks on the flight was missing and realised it must if dropped and would still be on the plane. We had the two very back seats 38F and 38E which are only two seats instead of three and we were the last two people to leave the plane as it was only exit at the front. As soon as I realised the wallet had been left somewhere around the seat I went straight to the customer service desk for Viva Aerobus this was around 30 minutes after departing the flight. Two female employees said they would check but they displayed no urgency even though I explained ALL our cards were in there and we had no way to pay for any transport, food, etc for our stay in Mexico. We couldn't really tell if they were helping as they were quite preoccupied with talking other people and then they said that the wallet had not been reported so unfortunately they cannot help any further. The wallet was definitely left on or under the seat and the only people left on the plane were the staff so only one of them could if stolen the wallet and left us in a terrible situation stranded in Mexico with no way to access any money! This is the most shocking experience I have ever had with any airline and they are white blatantly running a criminal operation, stealing what they can from customers and there's nothing you can fo about it. BE BERY VERY CAREFUL with this airline, don't leave anything on the seat and don't put anything valuable in your suitcase!

reviews.text: Leaving was on time and somewhat efficient. Returning encountered a cancelled flight due to 2 hours if morning fog at destination airport that had an expected arrival time of 6pm. The rebooked flight from next day was delayed at least three times. The third with very little warning. Download the app because you'll never reach customer service by phone. The first notice of cancellation said climate. Later that day they switched it to equipment. Next day delay was labelled climate again. Lack of transparency. I would not use this airline if possible .
reviews.author: Out of Town Guest - Moe

reviews.title: Unreliable and Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: This airline is a joke and their crappy reviews speak for themselves. Personally, I have never been motivated to leave a 1-star review for anything, but after getting swindled by Viva and dealing with their horrible service representatives, I felt obligated to warn others. Long story short, Viva delayed my flight by 3 hours, causing me to be miss my best friend's wedding. I pleaded with multiple customer service reps for a flight change, and all they did was heartlessly regurgitate policy, denying a change or cancellation. I've never dealt with such cold, unhelpful people in my life. As someone who travels between the US and MEX often, I am happy to say that I will never fly Viva again.
reviews.author: Lucas O

reviews.title: The review numbers speak for themselves
reviews.text: I have never left a review for any business, but my experience with this clown show is just too much to ignore. If you look at all the reviews you will see there were 598 people that gave VIVA an excellent rating, and 2120 people that gave VIVA a terrible rating. VIVA cancelled a flight that ultimately cost me over $2,000 in extra costs for new flights (missed our original flights because of VIVAs cancellation) and extra hotel accommodations. Do not let my review scare you away from traveling to and around in Mexico, the Mexican experience is wonderful, there are other airlines available. Don't make the mistake I made, read the reviews first and then book the flight!

Flight into Monterrey and from Chicago went very smooth . The only thing that could have made it better was internet! Please make sure you download music and movies before you board.

I then received an email to check-in I was able to check-in and even received my BOARDING PASS!!! BUT THEN 4 hours before my flight departure I received another email saying my payment needed another verification to process my payment. (on another hand my bank showed otherwise no issues the money was taken from my account) I contacted Viva to verify what was the issue they told me my payment didnt go through and I need to make the payment AGAIN with another card. The money taken out of my account is supposed to be refund to me yet 10 days later the issue has not been resolved. My bank also has an open case wih the airline trying to get my money back. NEVER flyhing with them again I rather pay a few dollars extra and fly with American Arlines. My flight was entire trip was CANCLED I was unable to board the plane.

reviews.title: Almost made up miss our flight
reviews.text: The flight never popped up on the flight board. we only found out where our flight was when they called our party by name over the intercom. Turns out around 30 people almost missed the flight because of this. It is also a super outdated plane with no usb and little to no leg room and I am only 6ft
reviews.author: mackenzie b

reviews.title: Avoid this airline at all costs
reviews.text: I have been delayed for 12 hours in the Monterrey Airport, they oversold 15% of the airplane capacity and have tried to book me and my family in the next three flights. But I am still here in Monterrey after 12 hours and can’t go back to Tijuana. Like many things in life, you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: RogerMty

reviews.title: NEVER BOOK WITH THIS COMPANY. IT’S A SCAM!!
reviews.text: This company is a complete scam. About four months back i bought three round trip tickets to Monterrey Mexico. My trip was planned three+ months in advance and about a week after purchasing the tickets I needed a refund and or points for the trip so that i could at least reschedule or get points to not lose out on my money. I contacted viva Aerobus over 20 times via email and calls which would only put me on hold for 30 minutes and then the call would hang up for timing out without me ever getting in contact with this company. That’s 1,500 that I’ll never get back. Do yourself a favor and NEVER EVER book with viva aerobus.
reviews.author: Kierra G

reviews.title: Listen to me. Do not fly with them. This is worse than you could ever imagine.
reviews.text: Listen, and listen carefully. This is not an airline. This is a device of pure antagonism. I have never seen anything like this in my life. LISTEN TO ME CAREFULLY. DO NOT GIVE ONE CENT OF YOUR MONEY TO THIS COMPANY. THIS COMPANY NEEDS TO GO BANKRUPT. IF IT CONTINUES TO EXIST, IT IS BECAUSE YOU ARE FUNDING ABUSE. The check-in agent swore at me many times. She told me go f* yourself when I asked if I could check another bag. She said no. I said, but your policy says I can check a second bag. She said I don't f* care. Go f* yourself. I don't f* care what you do with your second bag but you can't bring it and I don't f* care. And she swore at other people too. I asked to see a supervisor and she laughed and said that her supervisor will tell you to f* yourself and remove you from the flight. This is extreme abuse. Everyone had to dump their second bags. I mean throw them in the garbage. Then at the gate they made people throw things away from their carry-on bags.. Yes. For no reason. They said they were overweight when they weren't. People were CRYING. This airline DOES NOT DESERVE TO EXIST. If you have no money, do not fly on them. They will cheat you and lie. Fly on another airline or do not fly. Do not give them your money!!! This is the worst of the worst of the worst I have ever experienced. Stop. Do not book with them. They are even worse than you imagined possible.
reviews.author: Giles G
